headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers 7-1, with Edgar Quero leading the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. Grant Taylor pitched 2 scoreless innings for the Tigers. In other action, the Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, ending their opponent's winning streak, and the Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays in a thrilling finish.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins right-hander Bailey Ober, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other injured players include Milwaukee Brewers left-hander Angel Zerpa, Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Craig Kimbrel, San Francisco Giants center fielder Harrison Bader, Colorado Rockies left-hander Welinton Herrera, Athletics right-hander Luis Severino, and Cincinnati Reds right-hander Pierce Johnson.

The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The Colorado Rockies traded left-hander Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Philadelphia Phillies traded right-hander Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations. The Cincinnati Reds traded right fielder Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for right-hander Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Down Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox dominated the Detroit Tigers, winning 7-1 behind a strong team effort. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Grant Taylor pitched 2 scoreless innings for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, ending their opponent's winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 7-6 decision to the Texas Rangers, coming up just one run short of a comeback victory. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 strong innings for the Jays.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Bailey Ober Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-hander Bailey Ober has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
